I asked the clerk to fix it or give me my money back; he refused & said it would look normal on the other end. Now I don't have food until January. Thanks Fedex.

1593293510509215744.a: If, by chance, you have no cash (<$2200 I think) and need food in Marion Co, Indiana call 317-742-9111. Gleaners will hook you up with enough for everyone in your household. In my experience the food is very high quality; sometimes farm to table. Don't eat cheap garbage & suffer.

1593321235156443136.a: I visited the apartments where my father lived in my childhood. When I was 7 my father was trying to start his car with starter fluid. Sparked and the flame chased its way to the bottle. He had not planned for that. 40 years later that is still the only building with no carport.

1593321830273716224.a: And my father was no dolt. He was an machinist in the military, machined helicopter turbines after that, built race cars and motorcycles from age 15. Confidence, deserved or not, can kick your ass some days.
